customManagers.description: Update default values in Flux variable substitution OCI refs like ref.tag: ${VAR:-v1.2.3}
Update default image tags in Flux patches like image: ghcr.io/org/app:${VAR:-v1.2.3}

Update HelmRelease chart.spec.version defaults behind Flux variable substitution. The flux manager skips these as contains-variable, so the datasource/registry is supplied by a preceding renovate comment.

Update chart-version defaults threaded into a bundle's child Kustomization, e.g. infra/platform's `CERT_MANAGER_VERSION: "${CERT_MANAGER_VERSION:-v1.21.1}"` inside postBuild.substitute. These are a second copy of the base's default (a child CR cannot inherit it — an empty substitute value renders as YAML null and the API server rejects the CR), so they must be bumped in the same PR as the base or the bundle silently pins the old version.

Crossplane package refs written as a plain image:tag, e.g. `package: xpkg.crossplane.io/crossplane-contrib/function-kcl:v0.12.2`. No manager sees these: they are values inside a HelmRelease, not a container spec, so neither the flux manager nor the docker one picks them up and they simply never got updated.

Crossplane package refs whose tag is a Flux substitution default, `package: ghcr.io/org/pkg:${VAR:-v1.2.3}` and the provider list entries `- xpkg.../provider-helm:${VAR:-v1.4.0}`. Same blind spot as above, plus the variable, which is why the generic image manager cannot match them either.

packageRules.description: Hold function-auto-ready below v0.7.0. crossplane-configurations declares '>=v0.6.5,<v0.7.0' on it; a bump past that bound breaks dependency resolution for every package that depends on it, and the failure is a whole-graph Healthy=False, not a single unhealthy package. Raise this together with the constraint, not before it.

Group the crossplane-contrib packages so a registry change arrives as one reviewable PR. THE REGISTRY IS NOT INTERCHANGEABLE: each package here is on the registry the installed Configurations declare for it, and Crossplane keys its lock on the source string -- the other spelling of the same image reads as a missing dependency. Do not 'tidy' these onto one registry; that has to start in the packages' own dependsOn.
Group all stuttgart-things first-party images into a single PR

Group each homerun2 component on its own, so a component's image and its -kustomize artifact are always bumped in the same PR and cannot drift apart (see #208). Overrides the broad stuttgart-things grouping above.

Group clusterbook and clusterbook-operator each on their own, so a component's image and its -kustomize artifact always move in the same PR (same reason as homerun2, see #208) and a patch-only bump is not held back by an unrelated minor in the combined stuttgart-things group. Overrides the broad stuttgart-things grouping above.
Auto-merge patch and digest updates once CI passes — keeps low-risk bumps from piling up
Flag major updates for manual review; never auto-merge
